title: Your profile
lead: One profile for every application. Changes here never alter applications you've already submitted.
cnicFixed: Linked to your account and can't be changed.
ageNote: You never enter your age. It's calculated from your date of birth for each job.
sameAddress: Permanent address is the same as current address

education.empty: You haven't added any qualifications yet.
education.marksHint: For CGPA, enter the percentage shown on your transcript.

experience.lead: Add jobs you've held. Some posts need a minimum number of years.

skillsLead: Add only skills and licences that matter for the jobs you want, e.g. a driving licence or typing speed.
documentsLead: Upload each document once. We attach the right ones to each application. PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB.
additionalLead: Tick what applies to you. These can affect quotas and the documents a job asks for.

additional.governmentEmployeeNote: You'll need to upload a no-objection certificate (NOC).
additional.disabilityNote: Upload your disability certificate to apply under the disability quota.
additional.minority: I belong to a religious minority
additional.minorityNote: You may apply under the minority quota where available.

returnTitle: You were applying for a job
returnBody: Save your changes, then go back to your application.
